description: Save custom brand voice settings (tone, sample posts, avoid words, emoji/hashtag rules) for the authenticated user. Applied to future Jacks.

allow_emojis.description: Whether emojis are allowed in Jacks.

avoid_words.description: Specific words or jargon to exclude from Jacks.

name.description: Display name for the voice profile.

sample_posts.description: Representative real posts demonstrating your voice.

sign_off.description: Optional recurring sign-off line, e.g. 'More soon.'

tone.description: Description of desired tone, e.g. 'sharp, witty, industry-insider'.

name: set_voice_profile
